source: For AI kernels, register tiling is central to high-performance matrix multiplication and fused kernels because partial results can be accumulated close to the arithmetic pipelines. But aggressive register use increases pressure. Later handbooks will treat the register/occupancy trade-off quantitatively; here the architectural lesson is that registers are both a high-value resource and a finite residency budget.
zh: 对于 AI 内核，寄存器平铺是高性能矩阵乘法和融合内核的核心，因为部分结果可以在算术管道附近累积。但过度使用寄存器会增加压力。以后的手册将定量地处理登记/占用的权衡；这里的架构教训是，登记册既是高价值资源，也是有限的居住预算。
